bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
echo EXISTING_PUBLISHED_MENUS_STARTLESS_APPLY_BEGIN
set +e
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/refreshStartlessExistingPosts.mjs --apply
code="$?"
set -e
echo STARTLESS_BATCH_EXIT="$code"
if [ "$code" -ne 0 ] && [ "$code" -ne 2 ]; then exit "$code"; fi
echo STARTLESS_BATCH_RESULT_READBACK_BEGIN
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 sh -c 'psql -X -q -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -At -c "SELECT state,COUNT(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations GROUP BY state ORDER BY state;"'
echo STARTLESS_BATCH_RESULT_READBACK_END
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
echo STARTLESS_BATCH_COMPLETED
